title: Segmented sensitivity and drift bench for embedding and reranker config changes
creator: Asha Nair
description: Build a reusable offline evaluation harness that runs segmented recall/precision + rank-aware metrics (NDCG/MRR) and drift detectors across customer cohorts for any embedding or reranker config/model change. The bench should produce dimensioned metrics (by customer cohort, query-length, domain, and tokenization bucket), support synthetic perturbations to measure sensitivity to config knobs (quantization level, batching, cache TTL, model variant), and emit pass/fail signals consumed by rollout gating and alerting. Results must be reproducible, auditable, and linkable to PRs and rollout events.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness can run end-to-end offline evals for a submitted config/model diff and output a delta report with recall@k, precision@k, NDCG@10, MRR@10 for global and per-segment slices
2) Drift detectors (KS-test + distributional embeddings distance + rank overlap) run automatically and flag segments with statistically significant shifts
3) Sensitivity matrix generated that shows metric deltas by controlled perturbations (quantization, cache TTL, batch size) with visual heatmap export
4) Integration with rollout service: when thresholds exceeded, create an automated rollback recommendation or block auto-rollout; thresholds are configurable per-project
5) Bench commits results to quality dashboard and links to GitHub PR that triggered the run; reproducible artifacts stored in S3 with unique run IDs
steps: Design schema for segmented metric outputs and standardize slice keys (customer_id_hash, domain, length_bucket, vector_norm_bucket)
Prototype sensitivity perturbation runner that replays a sampled query set with controlled config changes
Implement statistical tests for drift (KS, Wasserstein, and rank overlap) and determine default thresholds via historical runs
Wire up CI job that triggers harness when a model/config change lands in staging and attach run ID to PR
Add gating hook into rollout service (canary and gradual rollout) to consume bench pass/fail and surface rollback suggestions
Create dashboard panels for per-segment time series, heatmaps, and an 'unstable segments' list with suggested mitigation
notes: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting; decided to reuse the existing quality-harness repo as the base and add a segmented output layer.

2026-02-25: Decided on primary slice keys to support (customer cohort, domain tag, length_bucket, vector_norm_bucket). Will add locale later if requested.
2026-03-02: Stat test selection: KS for token-level distribution shifts, Wasserstein for embedding distances, and normalized rank overlap (Jaccard/NDCG delta) for reranker outputs.
2026-03-05: Initial thresholds proposal: recall@10 drop > 3% AND ndcg@10 drop > 2% for critical cohorts = block rollout. Need to calibrate with historical runs (task assigned to ENG-33011).

2026-03-10: Design review feedback (PM + Design): include failure explanations and quick links to example queries demonstrating the regression; add suggested mitigations (increase cache TTL, use lower quantization, fallback model variant).

2026-03-11: Infra note: stored run artifacts will live under s3://redwood-quality-harness/runs/2026/ENG-48357/ and retention default 90 days; ask infra for lifecycle policy change if longer retention required.

rollback_policy: Auto-recommend rollback when persistent delta over 24h: recall@10 <= -3% AND ndcg@10 <= -2% for >=3 critical cohorts OR any critical cohort recall drop >=5% over 1h. Rollback will include suggested mitigations in the PR comment.
